# Sensor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Sensor`](gmeow-Sensor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Sensor>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory`](../../slices/sensory.md)

An agent that produces observations by responding to a stimulus — a physical device, a software process, or a biological perceiver. The observer in a sensory observation; the vantage of a [`SensoryObservation`](gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) may be a [`Sensor`](gmeow-Sensor.md), a person, or an organization. Co-equal: no sensor is privileged as the 'primary' observer ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md), [`gufo:FunctionalComplex`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-functionalcomplex)
